segments.an9.66:1.3: Rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho, viññāṇupādānakkhandho – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañcupādānakkhandhā.
segments.an9.66:2.1: “Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ pahānāya … pe … ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā”ti.
